verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm official Copilot Mobile apps on iOS and Android, and that connectors (OneDrive, Outlook.com, Google Drive, Gmail, Calendar) work there just as on Copilot.com. Nothing else in the evidence shows how complete the mobile apps are; voice and vision are documented but never tied to mobile. Missing for 10: documentation of mobile feature parity with web/desktop, mobile-specific capabilities such as voice and vision, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the mobile experience.
